current.messageZh: 強烈季候風信號現正生效。
current.messageEn: The Strong Monsoon Signal has been issued.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 受強烈東北季候風及一道雲雨帶影響，今明兩日廣東沿岸相當清涼，內陸地區早晚寒冷。隨著覆蓋廣東的雲帶在星期六轉薄，該區日夜溫差較大，早上仍然相當清涼。而一股達強風程度的偏東氣流會在下週初影響華南沿岸，該區雲量增多，氣溫稍為回升。預料另一股東北季候風會在下星期二抵達華南沿岸，下週中期該區將再度轉涼及有幾陣雨。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon and a band of rain and clouds, the weather will be rather cool over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cold in the morning and at night over inland areas. With the band of clouds covering Guangdong thinning out on Saturday, the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. It will still be rather cool in the morning. A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China early next week. It will be cloudier with temperatures rising slightly over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China next Tuesday. It will become cool again with a few rain patches over the region midweek next week.
